regime: Risk-off and aligned short. NQ and ES both closed below their stops, so Friday's index split is gone. Volatility ticked up on NQ and a violent open set a wide range. Gold broke to fresh highs while crude broke down. Reduced risk into the Wednesday data cluster and Jackson Hole week.
summary: Risk-off Monday. NQ never threatened its falling 29,283 stop and sold off all session, tagging a 28,948 low before closing 29,131, down 0.8%. ES gave up its one-day long and flipped below its 7,700 stop to close 7,674.5, so the indices are aligned short again after Friday's split. Gold was the mirror image, up 1.0% to fresh highs at 4,700 and holding well above a rising stop. Crude broke down hard, off 2.0% and losing both its stop and the 86 handle. Volatility ticked up too, NQ hourly ATR near 103 versus 83 Friday, and a violent open set a wide 296 point range that boxed the session in.
psychology: When the open is violent, the range it prints can trap you both ways. NQ dropped almost 300 points in the first hour, set a wide opening range, then chopped inside it the rest of the day. Chase the breakdown and you got shaken out on the bounce. Fade the bounce and you got run on the next flush. The edge on a day like that is patience. Let price close beyond the range, two hourly closes past the OR high or low, before you commit. A wide range from a fast open is an invitation to overtrade.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN
fullReport.html:
HTA OPEN (NY opening range from the 13:30 to 14:00 UTC window): OR high 29,244, OR low 28,948, width 296 points, set by a violent open bar. No 15 minute RTH close broke the range. Price traded entirely inside it, RTH high 29,233 under the OR top and RTH low 28,954 above the OR floor. An inside, range day, so no hand-off and no back-into-range trigger.

For Tuesday all four plays are eligible: BIR, HOF, MID and BNC. Monday's BIR skip does not apply on a Tuesday, and there is no CPI or FOMC. HOF avoids the 12:00 to 14:00 ET dead zone; MID is the 9:30 to 10:30 ET window only.

fullReport.html: E3v2 Momentum Long stays filtered out. NQ is below its 29,283 stop, which blocks the long-momentum entry, and the tape was two-sided chop inside a wide range rather than a clean breakout. Momentum is down under a falling stop.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band
fullReport.html: AVWAP deviation band (MNQ): close 29,131 versus AVWAP 29,132 is right at the mean, about 0 sigma. The plus 2 sigma band sits at 29,221 and the minus 2 sigma band at 29,044. No reversion edge until price stretches to a band. Gold did stretch to about plus 2.75 sigma at its 4,700 high intraday and reverted, but it closed back near its mean.
